peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Lower relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Lower relative price than most peers: 7.7% below its local comparables; 34 of 144 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (76.7): 4.3 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 306 of 405 similar developments with a figure (the same as 9). Context, not scored: resales in 20.8% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 3-bedroom: median $2,700,000 ($2,327 psf, 1,065–1,593 sq ft; 5 resales, Apr 2024–Mar 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,522 psf (range $2,299–2,761); 7.7% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $226,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Newton MRT about 280 m, Novena MRT about 640 m; closer than 432 of 551 similar developments (the same as 6). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 3 within 1 km and 7 within 2 km; nearest Anglo-Chinese School (Junior) about 620 m; more than 493 of 551 similar developments (the same as 48). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 7 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 330 m), more than 275 of 551 similar developments (the same as 68); nearest hawker centre Newton Food Centre about 350 m; nearest park Mount Emily Park about 1,290 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Sanctuary@Newton, 16 new sales, about 180 m; 32 Gilstead, 3 new sales, about 320 m; Piccadilly Grand, 1 new sales, about 1,390 m; 21 Anderson, 6 new sales, about 1,400 m; Orchard Sophia, 13 new sales, about 1,460 m; The Giverny Residences, 2 new sales, about 1,500 m; Duet @ Emily, 3 new sales, about 1,530 m; The Collective at One Sophia, 16 new sales, about 1,780 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 472 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 60 new sales and 1,154 resales (1,214 purchases); new sales were 4.9% of these purchases. Subsales (54) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Bukit Timah Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 420 m; Peck Hay Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 580 m; The Serra Residences (launch, launched, about 4 homes), about 1,220 m; Dorset Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,410 m; upcoming Sophia Meadow development, about 1,430 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 1,154 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 414 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 1,154 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,178 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−2%). Planning-area private resales −6.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
